## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible result.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused tests
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` are synchronized
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, generated build output, or unrestricted telemetry were committed
- [ ] UI changes were checked with keyboard navigation and at narrow and wide viewports

## Risk and rollback

Describe compatibility, security, privacy, or deployment risks and the smallest safe rollback.
